provisional: Animation-lab data only. Marker times were chosen by a human-style reading of hand-speed profiles and frames of third-party trial clips; they are not production timing and nothing here is read by combat.

weapon.notes: Placeholder longsword authored as primitive geometry in code. Grip offset and +Z blade axis were chosen from bone-axis measurements across Idle_Sword, Sword_Block and Sword_Attack.

known_defects: loop_seam: ~6.7 cm bone gap between last and first frame (visible pop each cycle); needs cleanup in Blender

slash.marker_rule: contact = first frame the blade midpoint enters the forward hemisphere; active_end = arc complete. Chosen from the blade path, not from hand speed alone.
known_defects: 0.43-0.45 s: hitch at the top of the windup (tip speed drops 10 -> 6.5 m/s then jumps to 42 m/s)
follow-through drives the tip to ~0.16 m above the floor
source keys the Armature node position (non-bone track); stripped at import, otherwise the additive layer lifts the body ~0.58 m

source_pacing.notes: Rule durations equal to the clip's own marker spacing (warp ratio 1.0 everywhere).
